producer: round-2 repair replay; prior builder and critic labels were not accepted without recomputation

frozenStateGeometry.method: For each compiled dump, hide-state membership is derived from actual rigid JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 selector membership. Degenerate selector-carrier faces are removed, then the remaining exact float-coordinate triangle multiset is compared by material to the sealed Round3 GLB.

anonymousBoardInspection.observations: All anonymous A/B pairs were visually coincident across eight fixed cameras. No rail, optic, ADS-axis, attachment, material, completeness, duplication, floating-part, or camera-framing discrepancy was seen.

magazineVisualInspection.observations: RAM-7 renders show only the curved magazine and exposed cartridges; DM56 renders show only the box magazine and cartridges. No receiver, barrel, stock, optic, or suppressor is present.

sources.fact: IW3 registers hideTags as the WFT_HIDETAGS weapon field.
The IW3 loader parses hideTags as an array and enforces the fixed array extent.
The IW3 WeaponDef capacity is eight hide tags.
Info-string arrays split on LF and CRLF.
The IW3 dumper serializes hide-tag array entries with literal LF separators.
The OAT XModel loader maps every surface bone membership into XSurface partBits.
CoD4 hidepart resolves a bone bit and submits the DObj hide mask.
CoD4 rendering intersects all four XSurface partBits words with the DObj hide mask and skips a hit surface.

grammarAndEngineSemantics.conclusion: Literal LF is valid IW3 hideTags grammar (maximum eight names). A compiled surface is hidden when any of its four partBits words intersects the DObj hide mask, and OAT derives those bits from actual bone membership. Selector-weight evidence in the unlinked GLBs therefore tests the real engine contract.

budget.method: Enumerated every nonempty model reference in every exact-checkpoint weapon override, applied only the eight round-2 field sets in memory, excluded the unchanged protected gunModel2/worldModel2 fields symmetrically for target weapons, and diffed the scoped unique model-name sets.
budget.accountingDomain: Complete-state primary-slot substitution only. Protected gunModel2/worldModel2 bindings are unchanged, are outside this delta, and are reported separately. This is not a measured integrated pool count.
budget.qualification: Projection only; no rebuilt integrated package, map load, or measured runtime pool behavior is claimed.
